units.liq: Sm³ per month: oil + condensate + NGL
units.oe: 1 Sm³ liquids = 1 Sm³ o.e.; 1000 Sm³ gas = 1 Sm³ o.e.

series.encoding: base64 of little-endian uint16; value = code × scale; index 0 is month `start`

sources.name: Marine Regions — Maritime Boundaries v12 (Flanders Marine Institute)
sources.attribution: Maritime boundaries: Flanders Marine Institute (2023), Maritime Boundaries Geodatabase v12, marineregions.org (CC BY 4.0)

sources.name: EMODnet Human Activities — pipelines and platforms (Denmark, Netherlands)
sources.attribution: Danish and Dutch pipelines: EMODnet Human Activities

sources.name: Norwegian Offshore Directorate (Sodir) — FactPages and FactMaps
sources.licence: NLOD 2.0 (Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data)
sources.attribution: Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by the Norwegian Offshore Directorate
sources.cadence: FactPages are synchronised daily; monthly production lands about a month in arrears

sources.name: North Sea Transition Authority (NSTA) — Open Data
sources.licence: NSTA Open User Licence (June 2023): free to copy, publish, distribute, adapt; commercial exploitation is not granted
sources.attribution: Contains information provided by the North Sea Transition Authority and/or other third parties
sources.cadence: PPRS field production is updated monthly, about two months in arrears; GIS layers as NSTA republishes them

sources.name: Danish Energy Agency (Energistyrelsen) — monthly and yearly production, field delineations; GEUS — installations
sources.licence: No licence stated on the data pages; Danish public-sector information, reusable under the PSI Act, attribution given
sources.attribution: Danish field data: Danish Energy Agency (ens.dk); installations via GEUS
sources.cadence: Monthly report about six weeks after month end; yearly workbook each spring

sources.name: NLOG — Netherlands Oil and Gas portal (TNO / Ministry of Climate Policy and Green Growth)
sources.licence: Public information; NLOG claims no intellectual property rights in the data it provides
sources.attribution: Dutch field data: NLOG (nlog.nl), TNO – Geological Survey of the Netherlands
sources.cadence: Monthly production about two months in arrears; WFS layers continuously
